# Load dataset

Subset a new small data set from the full dataset, with same structure as the small (reduced) dataset that we generated before.

```{r}
full <- readRDS("./datasets/whole_vHC_dataset.rds")
# to simplify: only choose Privitera.E2 as we did before for another small data
full <- full[, full$Experiment == "Privitera.E2"]
# still want to keep the experiment as the same batch
# in the first small dataset, we chose 16 samples.
# now we extract the other 16 samples (32 in total for exp STR3) to prevent overlapping between these two small datasets
se_small1 <- readRDS("./datasets/small_vHC.rds")
se <- full[,!(full$SampleName %in% se_small1$SampleName)]

dge <- DGEList(assay(se, "counts"))
mm <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data=as.data.frame(colData(se)))
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
# Filter lowly expressed genes
keep <- filterByExpr(dge, mm, min.count = 10)
# Subset SE to only filtered genes
se <- se[keep, ]

set.seed(1)
tmp <- SEtools::svacor(se, ~ 0 + group, numSVmethod = "be", method = "vst")
tmp <- SEtools::svacor(se, ~ 0 + group, numSVmethod = "leek", method = "vst")
# we use 2 SVs as "BE" suggested
se <- SEtools::svacor(se, ~ 0 + group, n.sv = 2, method = "vst")
se <- log2FC(se, "corrected", controls = grep("Ctrl", se$group), isLog = TRUE)

```

# DEA

```{r}
mm <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data = as.data.frame(colData(se)))
dge <- calcNormFactors(DGEList(assay(se)))
formula <- as.formula(paste(c("~ 0 + group", grep("^SV[0-9]+$",colnames(colData(se)),value=TRUE)), collapse="+"))
mm <- model.matrix(formula , data = as.data.frame(colData(se))) 
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, mm)
fit <- glmQLFit(dge, mm, pseudocount = 0.5)

#Define the constrasts to test for:
contrast <- makeContrasts(
  Stress_vs_CTRL = (groupFemale_Stress + groupMale_Stress) / 2 - (groupFemale_Ctrl + groupMale_Ctrl) / 2,  # Overall stress effect, averaged equally across both sexes
  F_M_Stress = (groupFemale_Stress - groupFemale_Ctrl) - (groupMale_Stress - groupMale_Ctrl),  # Sex*Stress interaction: does the stress response differ between sexes?
  F_vs_M_Ctrl = groupFemale_Ctrl - groupMale_Ctrl,  # Baseline sex difference (in Ctrls only) 
  F_vs_M_Stress = groupFemale_Stress - groupMale_Stress,  # Sex difference in Stress group
  F_Stress = groupFemale_Stress - groupFemale_Ctrl, # Stress response in females
  M_Stress = groupMale_Stress - groupMale_Ctrl, # Stress response in males
  levels = mm)

Results_M <- addlogFCSE(as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[, "M_Stress"]),Inf))) 
# Difference stress vs no stress in males

Results_F <- addlogFCSE(as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[, "F_Stress"]),Inf))) 
# Difference stress vs no stress in females

Results_interaction <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[,"F_M_Stress"]),Inf)) 
# Difference in response to stress between sexes

# use stageR to correct the Pvalue for interaction
Results2 <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[, c("F_Stress", "M_Stress", "F_M_Stress", "Stress_vs_CTRL")]),Inf))
pScreen2 <- Results2$PValue
names(pScreen2) <- rownames(Results2)

pConfirmation2 <- cbind(Interaction = Results_interaction[row.names(Results2),"PValue"])

stageRObj2 <- stageR(pScreen = pScreen2, pConfirmation = pConfirmation2, pScreenAdjusted = FALSE)
stageRObj2 <- stageWiseAdjustment(object = stageRObj2, method = "none", alpha = 0.05)

adj_PVals2 <- getAdjustedPValues(stageRObj2, onlySignificantGenes = FALSE, order = FALSE) #returns NA for non-significant gene in pScreen
adj_PVals2 <- as.data.frame(adj_PVals2)

Results_interaction$staged.FDR <- adj_PVals2[rownames(Results_interaction),]$"Interaction"
intDEGs <- rownames(na.omit(Results_interaction[Results_interaction$staged.FDR < 0.05, ]))

# save all the DEA results in SE object
rowData(se)$DEA.Stress_vs_CTRL <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[, "Stress_vs_CTRL"]),Inf)) 
rowData(se)$DEA.M_Stress <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[, "M_Stress"]),Inf))
rowData(se)$DEA.F_Stress <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[, "F_Stress"]),Inf))
rowData(se)$DEA.F_vs_M_Ctrl <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[, "F_vs_M_Ctrl"]),Inf)) 
rowData(se)$DEA.F_vs_M_Stress <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[, "F_vs_M_Stress"]),Inf)) 
rowData(se)$DEA.interaction <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[,"F_M_Stress"]),Inf)) 
rowData(se)$DEA.overall_result <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast),Inf)) 
rowData(se)$DEA.subset_overall_result <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast[, c("F_Stress", "M_Stress", "F_M_Stress", "Stress_vs_CTRL")]),Inf))
# save the staged.FDR for interaction for later use
rowData(se)$Interaction_staged.FDR <- adj_PVals2[rownames(se),]$"Interaction"

M_signif <- rownames(Results_M[Results_M$FDR < 0.05, ])
F_signif <- rownames(Results_F[Results_F$FDR < 0.05, ])

```

create an object for later use

```{r}
# save this for later use
stress_degs_MFunion <- union(M_signif, F_signif)
stressed_animals <- se[,se$Condition == "Stress"]$SampleName
mean_log2fc <- rowMeans(assay(se, "log2FC")[stress_degs_MFunion, stressed_animals])
filtered_stress_degs_MFunion <- mean_log2fc[abs(mean_log2fc) > 0.1]

DEGs <- list(
  MF_union_stress_degs = stress_degs_MFunion,
  MF_stress_degs_filtered = filtered_stress_degs_MFunion,
  Interaction_degs_stageR_by_subsetResults = intDEGs)

reference_small_obj = list(se = se, 
                   DEGs = DEGs)
saveRDS(reference_small_obj, "./objects/reference_analysis_small_obj_alternative.rds")
```
